native.hart_profile: Actual selected implementation/revision scope. Public FSK rules do not certify C8PSK, WirelessHART or HART-IP.
native.hart_phy: Actual wired modulation. FSK standard baseline1200bit/s; C8PSK9600bit/s is a different mode requiring actual matched modem. HART-IP/WirelessHART need separate transport paths.
native.hart_revision: Actual peer universal-command revision, unknown. Polling range and command capability must match it; not automatically latest7.
native.hart_role: Actual sending endpoint role, unknown. Requests originate at host; response/burst at field device.
native.hart_host_role: Actual interacting host identity, unknown. Primary/secondary arbitration and quiet times differ; not universal primary master.
native.hart_binding_source: Required actual registered modem/port/current-loop binding and both endpoint capabilities, unknown.
native.hart_device_source: Required actual device description/revision/commands/preamble and response behavior, unknown.
native.hart_physical_source: Required actual impedance/cable/power/coupling/modem/IS/filtering evidence, unknown; nominal FSK rate does not prove installation.
native.hart_schedule_source: Required actual host arbitration, command turnaround, retry/burst and complete transaction schedule evidence, unknown.
native.hart_mode: Actual request/response or device-supported enabled burst mode, unknown. Generic multicast is not wired HART burst.
native.hart_frame_kind: Actual frame direction/category; status and delimiter differ between request and field response/burst.
native.hart_address_format: Actual encoded short1-byte or long5-byte address; long unique identity is distinct from polling number.
native.hart_address_bytes: Actual address field octets: short1, long5. No arbitrary2/3/4-byte encoding.
native.hart_poll_address: Actual device polling number, unknown: rev5-or-earlier0..15, rev6+0..63. Point-to-point0 is a proposal, not a real device assignment.
native.hart_topology: Actual current-loop topology, unknown. Multidrop analog fixed-current behavior requires actual revision/device configuration.
native.hart_expanded_device_type: Actual14-bit expanded device type in qualified long-address layout, unknown; not an automatically generated device identifier.
native.hart_device_id: Actual24-bit device ID in qualified long-address layout, unknown; host and burst flags are separate.
native.hart_preamble_bytes: Actual transmitted0xFF preamble octets in public FSK profile. Peer-specific required length and detection loss matter;5 is not a safe default for every unknown peer.
native.hart_peer_preamble_bytes: Actual required preamble length learned from matching field device, unknown. Configured transmit preamble must be at least this.
native.hart_delimiter: Actual delimiter octet; qualified FSK encodes address length, expansion count and frame category. C8PSK delimiter rules not inferred from asynchronous FSK.
native.hart_expansion_bytes: Actual encoded expansion bytes matching delimiter. Normal0 proposal belongs to qualified public FSK layout; future extensions need revision evidence.
native.hart_command: Actual wire command octet, unknown. Command31 carries extended16-bit command in data; command support and response semantics remain device-specific.
native.hart_extended_command: Actual16-bit extended command when wire command31, unknown; its two bytes must be included in transmitted data length, not extra hidden overhead.
native.hart_command_source: Actual supported command, request/response data layout, units and encoding source, unknown. Generic data length does not prove functional command compatibility.
native.hart_status_bytes: Actual status length: request0, field response/burst2 in qualified FSK layout.
native.hart_data_bytes: Actual encoded data octets excluding response status, including extended-command bytes when present. Request/response layouts differ; no8-byte default.
native.hart_byte_count: Actual byte-count field = data plus status octets, excluding checksum. Response data at most253 when status2; not a universal complete255-byte frame limit.
native.hart_checksum_bytes: One transmitted XOR checksum octet in qualified public FSK layout; checksum covers delimiter through data, excluding preamble. Numeric length is not executed integrity evidence.
native.hart_checksum_source: Actual XOR calculation and observed parity/byte stream evidence, unknown; no auto-confirmed checksum or authentication.
native.hart_wire_octets: Actual whole frame incl preamble/delimiter/address/expansion/command/count/status/data/checksum. Separate from data and byte count.
native.hart_char_bits: FSK asynchronous character:1start+8dataLSB-first+odd parity+1stop=11bits. These bounds apply only to selected qualified FSK profile; not generic8N1.
native.hart_wire_bits: Actual serialization bits including all qualified FSK characters, not payloadÃ—8. C8PSK encoded stream needs actual physical evidence.
native.hart_serialization_ms: Actual frame serialization time from complete encoded bits and selected physical rate, excluding turnaround/gaps/arbitration; not whole transaction latency.
native.hart_gap_us: Actual worst inter-character gap; qualified FCG FSK rule requires less than one11-bit character time. No universal gap0 default.
native.hart_slave_timeout_chars: Qualified FieldComm2016 FSK slave timeout28character times; timeout is not actual device processing latency or application deadline.
native.hart_hold_chars: Qualified FieldComm2016 FSK HOLD2character times, separate from frame serialization and actual modem turnaround.
native.hart_link_grant_chars: Qualified FieldComm2016 FSK link grant RT2=8character times.
native.hart_quiet_chars: Qualified FieldComm2016 FSK RT1 primary33/secondary41character times. Master identity must be explicit.
native.hart_response_start_ms: Actual request-end to response-start upper bound incl device and modem, unknown; qualified FCG timeout relation applies. Does not include response duration.
native.hart_retry_limit: Actual host/device retry budget, unknown; no inherited CAN0 or Siemens client-specific universal value.
native.hart_retry_bound_ms: Actual total additional retry/arbitration recovery bound, unknown. Per-message or transport-independent timeout cannot substitute.
native.hart_burst_supported: Actual endpoint burst capability confirmed by device source, unknown; enabling mode must not fabricate support.
native.hart_burst_period_ms: Actual device/revision configured burst schedule, unknown. Tutorial3-4updates/s is illustrative, not a universal standard period.
native.hart_loop_load_ohms: Actual loop receiver resistor/communication load for qualified TI FSK example230..600Ohm, typically250. Bounds are not universal total loop impedance; device-specific topology requires actual source.
native.hart_loop_supply_v: Actual loop supply and device compliance budget, unknown; not a universal24V supply.
native.hart_loop_current_ma: Actual operating analog loop current, unknown;4..20mA measurement range and multidrop fixed current are not arbitrary digital defaults.
native.hart_signal_pp_ma: Actual FSK signal amplitude at matched load, unknown.1mApp is nominal tutorial value, not measured endpoint evidence.
native.hart_cable_cap_pf: Actual cable/receiver capacitance and length/loading bound, unknown; not I2C400pF or an inferred universal cable length.
native.hart_is_required: Actual hazardous-area/intrinsic-safety requirement, unknown; HART name does not imply certified safe installation.
native.hart_is_source: Actual matched barriers/entities/cable/loop intrinsically-safe certification evidence, unknown; separate from message checksum.
native.bitrate: Actual selected wired HART rate: FSK1200 vs C8PSK9600bit/s; baselineFSK1200 source-backed proposal, no Ethernet/WirelessHART fallback.
native.payload_bytes: Actual encoded HART data length excluding response status, equal hart_data_bytes when both supplied; wire/count/status/extended-command framing reviewed separately; no universal8-byte default.

removed.queue_size: No universal HART256-frame queue; actual host modem/stack buffer evidence is required.
removed.queue_policy: No universal HART FIFO schedule; half-duplex dual-host access and burst rules govern actual arbitration.
removed.qos_priority: HART FSK has no CAN priority3 or Ethernet PCP; primary/secondary host identity is separate.
removed.reserved_bandwidth_percent: No universal HART reserved bandwidth0%; actual host/burst transaction schedule is required.
removed.sync_method: No NTP/PTP time-sync fallback for wired HART; FSK preamble character synchronization differs.
removed.retransmission_enabled: Actual HART retry capability and policy require matched endpoint source; no generic network retransmission switch.
removed.retransmission_rate: No universal HART retry probability0; actual retry bound and budget are separate.
removed.retry_limit: Use actual native HART host retry budget; inherited generic0 is unsourced.
removed.retransmission_delay_ms: Use actual native retry/arbitration bound, not generic0ms.
removed.gateway_maximum_throughput: No100Mbit/s HART gateway default; modem loop capacity and actual upstream binding are separate.
removed.gateway_input_buffer: No universal256-frame HART gateway input buffer.
removed.gateway_output_buffer: No universal256-frame HART gateway output buffer.
